application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
Front Garden (left  Boundary) 
T1: Holly tree – Remove dead and declining sections of the crown 

Height of tree currently:  6M
Height of tree after reduction:  5M

Spread of tree currently:  4M
Spread of tree after reduction: 3M

Reasons for work: 
We have inspected the holly tree and found it to be showing signs of decline, with extensive stag-heading and dieback evident throughout the upper crown. Although some live growth remains, the amount of dead material present indicates that the tree is under physiological stress, 

-	We  will removing the dead and declining sections of the crown to reduce the overall stress placed on the tree and to encourage the regeneration of healthy new growth. The tree should then be monitored over time to assess its response to these works, as continued decline may necessitate further management or eventual removal.
